S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.

subtypes.Chronic Worry: Worry occurs more days than not for at least 6 months.
subtypes.Generalized Worry: Worry is not confined to specific topics but spreads to various domains like work, school, family, and finances.
subtypes.Catastrophizing: Jumping to conclusions that minor mistakes or events will lead to irreversible disasters.
subtypes.Intolerance of Uncertainty: Unable to tolerate future uncertainty, trapped in 'what if' questions.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.

subtypes.Failure to Control: Unable to regulate worry despite efforts to stop or distract oneself.
subtypes.Intrusive Worry: Worries suddenly intrude into the mind and interfere with focus while doing other tasks.
subtypes.Chaining of Worry: One worry triggers another in a chain reaction, escalating to catastrophic thoughts.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.

subtypes.Feeling Keyed Up: Feeling anxious and wound up like a spring, unable to stay still.
subtypes.Physical Tension: The entire body feels stiff and tense, unable to relax.
subtypes.Nervousness: Nerves are on edge, being startled easily by minor sounds or stimuli.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.

subtypes.Neck and Shoulder Tension: Muscles in the shoulders and back of the neck are knotted and stiff, causing pain or headaches.
subtypes.Jaw Tension: Clenching teeth or tension in the jaw causing jaw pain or headaches.
subtypes.Generalized Muscle Aches: Muscles all over the body, including back, arms, and legs, are stiff, painful, and easily fatigued.
subtypes.Chronic Stiffness: Muscles remain in a constant state of tension and do not relax.

patient_info.stressor: Alejandro’s materials-science lab underwent a major readjustment when a funding shift pushed the team toward a commercial partnership, new reporting metrics, tighter publication timelines, and uncertainty about junior staff roles. Initially he tried to manage by extending his routines, reorganizing data files, and hiking more, but over 7 months his worry generalized from job security to experiment reliability, finances, family expectations, community commitments, and future graduate plans. The worry became difficult to control and was accompanied by persistent fatigue, restlessness, and muscle tension that began to impair his concentration in the lab, delay technical writing, and make even art nights or cooking for family feel burdensome. After missing a key internal deadline and recognizing that his usual coping structure was no longer enough, he contacted his employer’s behavioral health service and was referred for psychiatric evaluation.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.
S056.manifestation: I came in because my mind is constantly jumping from whether our lab's new partnership is going to cut my position to whether my data are wrong, my bills are going to pile up, my family thinks I'm falling behind, and whether I've already ruined my chances at grad school.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: Even after a full night in bed, I wake up feeling like I've already pulled an all-nighter, and by the time I'm labeling samples or trying to cook dinner for my family, my body feels heavy and my brain feels drained.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.
S057.manifestation: I try to tell myself to focus on one task, like finishing a report or checking an assay, but one worry sets off another and pretty soon I'm staring at the screen while my head is running through every possible way things could go wrong.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.
S058.manifestation: At work I feel wound up like I can't settle into my chair, so I'm tapping my foot, checking messages, walking back to the instrument room for no reason, and getting startled by normal lab noises.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.
S061.manifestation: My shoulders and neck stay so tight during the day that I catch myself clenching my jaw over spreadsheets and by evening I have headaches and stiffness like I've been carrying equipment around all day.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I missed an internal lab deadline because I couldn't organize my writing and data review, and now even routine responsibilities like preparing reports, showing up for art nights, or cooking for my family feel like too much to keep up with.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about seven months, since the lab's funding shift and commercial partnership changed how everything was being run.
